finding: An agent that runs the two code blocks of steps 5 and 6 as written gets 'command not found'. The blocks call the bare names gate-setup-proof and crap-score from the root of the project, and the installed scripts folder is not on PATH. Line 30 gives the path only relative to SKILL.md, as ../../scripts/, so the agent must work out .agent-factory/factory/scripts/ by itself. crap-score/SKILL.md and the other skills write the full path .agent-factory/factory/scripts/<script>. The text avoids that path because the test of CG-03-LN-02 reads every file under setup-crap-score/, also SKILL.md, which the skill never copies into a project. The developer recorded that drift as the first row of docs/spec/work/spec-feedback-ST-0448.md. Fix: once the test-strategy agent narrows CG-03-LN-02 to the files that the skill copies, write both calls in SKILL.md as .agent-factory/factory/scripts/gate-setup-proof and .agent-factory/factory/scripts/crap-score, as crap-score/SKILL.md does.
why_this_severity: The text exists only on the story branch. Line 30 names the folder and says where it lies, so an agent still finds and runs both scripts (no to fails_purpose). Each setup run then costs a failed command and a path search, and the call differs from the one in crap-score/SKILL.md.
